lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Birdie！

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Listen to this!

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Ugh, she's at it again.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Yesterday, we had a hero meeting at a barbeque restaurant.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: The meeting I went to was a villain's meeting...

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: But there was a big problem!

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Problem? What problem?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Everything went perfectly fine.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: It's you, Maxwell.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: You're the problem.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: I am??
She is?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: It's because of her that I couldn't concentrate during yesterday's meeting.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: On that, we can agree.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: She kept insisting that I eat more vegetables, and was piling them on my plate.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: She even tried to feed me some against my will.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: That's because you eat too much red meat.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: It's important to eat a balanced meal.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Isn't that right, Cutey?
You really should introduce more variety into your diet, Drake.
To only eat what you like is the most villainous thing of all.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Hmm... I guess you're right.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Hey, it's important for villains to have a balanced diet too!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: And that's not all.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I had this piece of meat on the grill that was a real beauty,

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: then Maxwell went and flipped it over!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I had been taking plenty of good care of it without her butting in.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Says you.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: If I hadn't flipped that burger over, you would have ended up eating raw meat.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Food should always be cooked properly.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: A hero needs to forever be ready to move out within a moment's notice.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Eating quickly is imperative.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Well, what do you think, Cutey?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Have I said anything that was out of line?
Doesn't seem like it.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I'm not finished yet!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: There was also a mistake with the order.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: There was?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: You ordered 13 servings of meat.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: How could the three of us handle that much meat?!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: We only ended up eating half of it.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: It's terrible to waste food like that.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: You're the one who placed the order, Drake.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Oh yeah, I accidentally put a '1' before the '3'.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: So it was you who fouled up!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Villains do not "foul up"!
Well, in the end, Maxwell didn't do anything wrong.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Exactly!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: If that's your take on it, Birdie, then there's not much I can do.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Fine, I'll forgive you, Maxwell, just this once.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I'll never forgive you!

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Ha...
Good luck dealing with these two.
